name: cavemio-clarifying-question
title: Clarifying Question
description: The agent pauses to ask. Pick with a click or a number key, or type your own; it folds into a one-line receipt.

cavemio.usage:
import { ClarifyingQuestion } from "@/components/clarifying-question";

<ClarifyingQuestion question="Which shop is this plan for?" options={[{ id: "main", label: "Main Street" }, { id: "harbour", label: "Harbour Road" }]} onAnswer={handleAnswer} />
cavemio.accessibility: Options are labelled radio buttons or checkboxes. Arrow keys move between rows; number keys pick options. Enter submits custom text and Escape returns to options. Answered options are inert and a status region announces the receipt. Reduced motion disables folding, the status pulse, and text/counter movement.
cavemio.previewNote: Reuses Number Roll and Text Morph. Demo answers stay local; connect onAnswer and onSkip to your application or AI tool output.

props.name: question
props.description: Required. Question displayed to the user.

props.name: detail
props.description: Optional. Supporting explanation below the question.

props.name: options
props.description: Required. Available choices with stable IDs and labels.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Optional. Allow several answers, confirmed with Continue.

props.name: allowOther
props.description: Optional. Offer "Something else" with a field.

props.name: otherLabel
props.description: Optional. Label for the custom-answer choice.

props.name: answer
props.description: Optional. The answer once given, e.g. the tool's output; shows the folded line.

props.name: onAnswer
props.description: Required. Called with the selected or custom answer.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Optional. Shows Skip; the agent continues with its own choice.

props.name: skipped
props.description: Optional. Whether the question has been skipped.

props.name: skippedText
props.description: Optional. Text displayed for a skipped question.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Optional. Move focus into the question when it appears.
